payload.title: Migrate component gold to structured identity
payload.description:
Migrate component gold onto the structured canonical representation.

| gold key shape | instances | migration |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| `type:<taxonomy subtype id>` — `asset:database` x182, `asset:api` x118, `asset:auth_service` x110, `asset:service` x41, `asset:cache` x14, `asset:config` x8, `actor:customer`, `actor:admin` | 481 | mechanical: every rest is a literal `component-taxonomy.yaml` id |
| `third_party:<vendor>` — auth0 x17, stripe x13, supabase x5, sendgrid x5, and 8 more | 52 | mechanical; retains the instance field |
| `actor:user` | 30 | blocked on the taxonomy gaining `user` |

Of the 12 distinct vendors, six are outside `known_third_party_names`: `github_auth`, `twitter_auth`, `facebook_auth`, `oidc`, `ldap`, `checkr`.

Blocked on the component instance ruling, which decides whether the 473 asset `subject.name` values (`directus_users`, `LocalAuthDriver`, `UsersService`) become the canonical instance or stay evidence/display.
